pages.text: A sound behind you is ordinary. Several creatures arriving from different directions deserve more attention.
pages.title: Being noticed
The answering country
pages.text: The bar at the top of the screen shows how closely the country is attending to you. Its next mark is a warning. Prepare to move before it is reached. A charm protects against infection; it does not conceal your presence.

pages.title: Buy time
pages.text: Settling a checkpoint lowers attention. Leaving the dimension lets it subside. Neither death nor logging out wipes the record of your stay.

pages.title: Buy time
pages.text: Repeated successful operations establish a foothold and slow its rise. A liberated dimension no longer pursues you this way. Home is sheltered by the Stillness unless a local field has deliberately been opened.
